title: Frontiers: In-Consumption Social Listening with Moment-to-Moment Unstructured Data: The Case of Movie Appreciation and Live Comments
authors: Qiang Zhang; Wenbo Wang; Yuxin Chen
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional movie-level OLS of appreciation measures (ratings) on the moment-to-moment synchronicity measure (MTMS) built from live comments, with UGC and content controls and genre dummies (Tables 2-3). No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: main results/table2_full_sample.do, table2_horror_thriller.do, table3_quartiles.do: reg $dv mtms $varugc $varmean $varstd $varctrl $genre [ln_view], robust on movie_data.xlsx; video processing code for audio/image features.
software_notes: Stata; MATLAB and Python for video feature extraction.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
